description: 3DBI is a 3D model viewer for Microsoft Power BI. The 3DBI visual will allow you to visualize your data about your assets directly in its spatial context. Use cases range from Property Management, BIM (quantities, scheduling, …) to plotting IoT data (color and filter objects by temperature, humidity, co2-levels, occupancy, wear, …) as well as Logistics (stock management, order picking, …) and Energy (plotting yield of solar panels or windmill farms) or any other sector where you might have a need for visualizing data in a 3D environment. Out of the box, and without an AppSource license, the 3DBI visual allows you to load in .3dbi files, created with one of the Creational tools offered by INFORMAXYZ (read more below). With an AppSource license, the 3DBI viewer can also load in open 3D file formats, such as Collada (.dae), created with a wide range of available 3D modelling applications. The Creational tools INFORMAXYZ currently has available to create .3dbi files are: 1. Trimble SketchUp: https://kg-dev.be/project/3dbi-for-sketchup/ 2. Autodesk Revit: https://kg-dev.be/project/3dbi-for-revit/ 3. IFC files: https://kg-dev.be/project/3dbi-for-ifc/ Tutorials on how to generate a model suitable for the 3DBI visual for Power BI can be found on the respective pages. Licensing information for those Creational tools is also available on the same pages.
